content: LLM resume tailoring failure modes: outright fabrication (adding Kubernetes/AWS never used) and subtler 'conflation' — assembling true facts from different parts of a profile into one coherent-sounding but false bullet (e.g., attributing a capstone detail to a current job). Mitigations: constrain edits to keyword-level rewrites of existing content, diff-based review UI, cross-reference every generated claim against source resume, dual-LLM verification frameworks that reject unverified skills.
